cij_SW.note: NEW pin-registered leaf on hb_coll_SW.inj_d: per inject lane, selects the SU-quarter answer (addr_lo[39]=0) or an 8-flit staging file of the actual INDEX TopK link frames hb_idx.tx (addr_lo[39]=1, slot=flit16[2:0]). Fixed latency: request pins P -> pin capture P+1 -> read stage P+10 -> inj_d register P+11 -> COLL qslots capture P+12 (=INJLAT). SU answer must be registered at P+9 (2 edges of join). IDX tx registered at T -> captured T+1 -> staged T+2; a COLL IDX inject needs P+10 >= T+3 and must read emit k before emit k+2 overwrites it (16 edges). Faults (sticky, never stall): stale or empty slot vs inj_idx flit, addr_hi != addr_lo+8, partial emit. ~10.3k flops; est. 0.006 mm2 ASAP7. notes.cp1: ONE new master ot_static_cmd_target (MODE 0 run collar for 32 svg, MODE 1 command calendar for 4 x-load + 4 DMA) + the existing ot_static_program_target for the 4 VM calendars. All collars take the raw host F20 broadcast; every input is pin-flopped and every output is a flop (owner 19:50). Fixed latencies: cfg row -> target window write 2 edges after cfg_v at the collar pin; launch_v -> run_v 2 edges; MODE 1: a table entry fires (cmd_v at the collar pin) when the exported cycle == C + 2 + LEAD(8) + loop*period + at, C = cycle value in the launch_v pin cycle; x-load / DMA add their own command-pin edge on top (cl2 ctl cmd_v pin flop; DMA DESC_LAT4). Table read is one entry per 3 edges sustained (2-deep prefetch: 2 back-to-back after a gap); a command whose cycle passes before it reaches the head is a sticky FAULT, never a late issue (static schedule, no ready/credit). Status: each collar exports configured/fault/active (status_outputs); cp2 joins them into the ingress block_ready/program_active/program_fault. Physical: the 256-b cfg_data broadcast now has ~48 more sinks (44 collars + COLL); it is install-time only but single-cycle at 1.2 GHz, so the parent must give it a pipelined relay tree (fixed edges, the collars are edge-count agnostic: install latency only). smvm_0030: SM_RESULT_TO_VM: all 32 SMs rv/rrow/rdata -> smw_<q> (4 x one master); fault/schedule_fault -> smw_<q> pin flops -> sticky writer fault -> cp_smw_<q>.tgt_fault -> host_status row of TARGET 160+QID (participation-filtered; no child join: an empty child would veto launches that do not use the writer).

Static timing: SM rv cycle t -> smw pin t+1 -> FIFO t+2 -> wq valid in cycle t+3 (slot 0), slot p at t+3+p; bank samples wq and wslot at the same edge (n), writes the macro at n+3. A row arriving while the SM lane still emits starts at the previous row end. COMPILER ROW-DEALING RULE (attn 2026-10-16, ARGMAX.LOCAL index = word position): VM word = 64*(base_row+p*stride_row+r[11:3])+8k+r[2:0]. Decision: COMPILER-WINDOWED K-PORT SHARE of all 32 PCs per quadrant (option 1 of grants_v7_1925 (3); no dedicated PCs, so SM weight bandwidth is lost only inside compiler-placed VM windows). Per quadrant: (a) vmks_<q><k> = ot_hbm_svc_vm_kshare #(SM=k) between svg_<q><k> and its 4 controllers (engine region, full_die_v16.engine_region): NORM passes the group K traffic; a window command (vm_*) holds new group requests at the K boundary (the allowed HBM flow-control boundary), drains the group beats in flight, issues 16 x len-4 reads per PC (64 slots, address {row,j[2:0],{col,j[3]},P^col^{row[1:0],j[2:0]},00}), steers the 64 returning beats by phase into a Gray SPSC FIFO to stream_clk and emits delivery fills; (b) vmdel_<q><b> = ot_hbm_svc_vmdel_lane x8 (the existing hardened v3 delivery lane, wires-only split parent flattened): landing (begin / fill / block_ready) and the compiler start -> 256 cycles of dq to VM bank b (sector = base + slot*32 + P); (c) vmfc_<q> = ot_vms_calendar_static #(W=89): one programme word per stream edge, fields begin_v[0:1), begin_bank[1:2), begin_epoch[2:18), start[18:19), start_bank[19:20), start_epoch[20:36), start_base_sector[36:52), vm_v[52:53), vm_bank[53:54), vm_epoch[54:70), vm_row[70:85), vm_col[85:89). Compiler rules: begin(bank,epoch) at or before the window command of the same bank/epoch; start no earlier than the bound on window drain + HBM return + CDC (landing start_ok checks block_ready and faults otherwise -- a schedule error is detected, never waited on); calendar_<q> reserves wslot WG+4 (dq) on all 8 banks for the 256 readout edges from start + 3 (lane pin registers). Fixed latencies added by the new leaf: group K request +1 hbm edge, group K response +1 hbm edge (II=1); VM beat -> fill_v: CDC 2 sync + 2 edges. Same window cost on every PC of the quadrant. (d) sfault_<q> = ot_hbm_svc_stack_fault: the channel-pair CA check + sticky fault join of controllers, groups, share leaves, delivery lanes and the calendar (status out to the host status consumer, G-STATUS). Write-back (VM -> HBM, G-DMA) can use the same window: ot_hbm_svc_vm_kshare passes group writes now; a VM write window is the natural extension, not built here.

notes.hbm_fault_1017:
HBM-FAULT 2026-10-17 (coordinator 0da+ (b)): regional sticky fault-aggregation tree for the HBM d4f die.

The 136 unread fault outputs of the d4f tie contract (HBM-TIE class MISSING: LG banks, LG term banks, SU pgslices,
SU qcores, SU bridge releases, VMS ring faults, COLL retry, DMA mv_fault, argmax nan_flag, COLL inj/idx join, stack
fault joins + their 7-bit cause) feed a tree of ot_hbm_fault_leaf tiles that ends at the host status join, remastered
to ot_hbm_status_join_fa (ot_hbm_status_join + NA region-root inputs, region cause vector, F20 fault-clear target).

Tree (no star hub, neighbour-only, every hop registered; the die relay planner adds registered stations on hops over
the reach):
  fl_<Q><k>  (Q in SW SE NE NW, k 0..3) one per SU slice column of the region row: the six LG banks of column k
             (lg_<Q>_{0,1,2}_b{2k,2k+1}, placed at x ~0.4/3.4/7.5/10.6 mm beside su_<Q>k) + su_<Q>k.fault (serial
             domain: SYNC) + child fl_<Q><k-1> (k > 0).  Chain west -> east toward the region root.
  fs_<S>     (S in SW NW) beside the stack fault join sfault_<S> (PHY edge): fault + status[6:0] (the stack cause).
  fr_<Q>     region root beside coll_<Q>: hb_vms_<Q>.ring_fault[2:0], hb_coll_<Q>.retry_requested, subr_<Q>.fault,
             hb_dbk_<Q>.mv_fault (SW NW), cij_SW.fault (SW), hb_argmax.nan_flag (NE), sucore_<Q>.fault (serial: SYNC),
             children fl_<Q>3 and fs_<Q> (SW NW).
  host_status (ot_hbm_status_join_fa NA 4): a_fault[i] = fr_<Q>.fault, region cause a_cause[i] (i = SW SE NE NW).
Leaves are registered ORs (2 edges, 3 for SYNC bits); the fault is held (sticky) at the join until the host writes an
F20 row to target FCLR (125); it raises die_fault (host status flit) and holds block_ready low (launch refused).
